  * __Resource Management__ –  Get the resources  you have already, check SMS coverage for alphas and numbers, and manage inbound configuration
  * __Resource Request__ –  check the necessary requirements, then submit and track requests for new resources, and receive request status updates on a webhook

description.content:
The __Resource Management API__ streamlines the process for handling and configuring registered communication resources, such as __alphanumeric senders__ and __numbers__.

With the __Resource Management API__:
  * Set up configuration for inbound messages
  * View existing configurations
  * View SMS coverage for alphanumeric senders or numbers
  * List all the resources, including senders and usable numbers

Use this API to maintain full control over your messaging resources.

For more information, see [Manage resources](https://www.infobip.com/docs/resources/manage-resources).

Get all configurations using a filter.
If you want configuration for a specific number or resource, then one of the following parameters is required: number, numberKey, resource or resourceKey.
If you are using configurationKey none of previously mentioned parameters are needed.

query.description: Unique ID of configuration.
Unique ID of a number.
Unique ID of a resource.
Configuration keyword.
(Required) Required if number, numberKey, resource or resourceKey present.
Country code in two-letter ISO standard. Required for identifying country specific resources (for instance, short code number types).

The __Resource Request API__ streamlines the process of requesting alphanumeric senders and numbers. This API enables seamless integration with Infobip’s registration and purchasing system.

Some resources require additional data for registration, known as __data requirements__. These vary depending on the type of resource being requested and may include documentation or specific business details.

The API also provides status tracking for all submitted requests. Some feedback is provided over email with [Infobip Support](mailto:support@infobip.com).

For more information, see [Request resources](https://www.infobip.com/docs/resources/request-resources).
